text: Done, uncommitted in the working tree on top of bc7a418. Cause: before work on an accepted release, the repository rereads it under today's rules and compared the reread profile with the profile of the new work. When the new work would change the dataset's kind (an archive becoming BIDS), that comparison failed and the answer was 'reassessment required'; re-assessing an archive still yields an archive, so the same answer came back forever. Fix in modules/application/.../NativeRepository.scala (readsAsRecorded): a profile mismatch after the reread is a change of kind and gets one final Unsupported outcome that says a dataset keeps its kind and the converted collection is deposited as its own dataset. Reassessment is still required only when the reading itself differs. Criteria: 1 the loop is reproduced in a shared test that fails on the old code; 2 the outcome is the same before and after re-assessing and accepting the archive, and docs/http-api.md and the DatasetInterpreter comment say the same, as does the AmbiguousDatasetKind finding; 3 unchanged-content re-assessment and same-kind additions still pass. Evidence: CatalogCoverageSuite law on both catalogs (CoverageLevelsSuite, CoveragePersistenceSuite), UpgradeSuite and UpgradePersistenceSuite, and the full scripts/check-postgres.sh gate. Not reachable from the browser or HTTP today: uploads merge with the base, so a user who adds a BIDS descriptor to an archive gets the AmbiguousDatasetKind finding, whose text now says what to do.
